_comment: Stitch MCP server entry — mirror of the repo-root .mcp.json. NEVER put OAuth client IDs or secrets in this file or in .mcp.json: both are tracked in a PUBLIC repo. Claude Code stores an OAuth client secret in the system keychain, not in config. If the server needs pre-configured credentials, register them locally: `claude mcp add --scope local --transport http --client-id <id> --client-secret stitch <url>` (prompts for the secret with masked input). Note: mcp.stitch.withgoogle.com did not resolve in DNS as of 2026-09-22.
